name: Serial Dumper
source: Serial Dumper is a multilinear textual adventure in which you play the role of a serial dumper, that is someone who continually breaks love relationships. But instead of dumping the “victim” you will have to make him/her leave you, through your mobile phone! Be prepared to use all the tricks of the trade!
translation: 《连环倾销者》是一款多线性文本冒险游戏，你在其中扮演连环倾销者的角色，即不断破坏爱情关系的人。但你不能抛弃“受害者”，而是必须通过你的手机让他/她离开你！准备好使用所有的交易技巧！
